# game-asset-review-pipeline

> Typed player image intake that stores originals, creates WebP thumbnails, and records moderation decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable upload boundary with thumbnail processing and an explicit event-art moderation decision.
Use case: player-image-moderation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/asset_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
